name: pocketledger
description: PocketLedger: a single-account accounting system. Express + TypeScript API, React + TypeScript web UI, and an Expo React Native mobile app, over shared logic.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
